headline: Contested Sectors Stir as Fronts Shift
war_summary: The latest returns show the war’s movement broadening, though the heaviest ledger remains concentrated in familiar contested ground. Weathered Expanse has become the busiest front, rising from 23 to 37 ownership events in the daily record; four came in the latest two-hour window, with its nine bases divided four to five. Callahan’s Passage remains sharply active at 22 events, including three recent, and its ten holdings stand eight Warden to two Colonial. Stonecradle also quickened in the day’s accounting, reaching 19 events from the previous edition’s 13, though none arrived in the latest two hours; seven bases are Colonial and two Warden. Stlican Shelf now shows 17 daily events, two recent, and remains split five Colonial, three Warden, with one neutral. Linn Mercy has edged from five to seven events, but reports no fresh movement in two hours. Nevish Line’s current ledger records 14 events, one recent and four in six hours, with six Warden and two Colonial bases. Most other regions remain quiet on ownership, leaving these divided sectors the clearest watchpoints for the next day.
